curated_comment: All 24 features correctly annotated as 1. Utudnon (= Baybayanon, ISO bvy) is a Philippine Austronesian language with a classic voice/focus (trigger) system. All grammatical contexts show ergative-absolutive alignment according to Rubino (2005). Ergative and genitive share the marker 'ni'; ergative and instrumental also coincide (GB409_23=1, GB409_24=1). Glottocode bayb1234 is correct from the start; the previously proposed utud1238 does not exist in Glottolog.
